value.rationale: Natural exhaustive boundary for coordinated reset control of three complete three-state machines. Unlike individual or pair results, the simultaneous triple threshold is sharply seven, and the full 165,469,149 labeled-triple shortest-length distribution and 28 signature types are determined. This is a complete finite classification, not an arbitrary subcase or routine substitution; generic product bounds leave the threshold open.
